categories.main_business_segments: Jahen Household Products Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the OEM/ODM manufacturing of daily chemical products including cosmetics and household care products, as well as the design and production of plastic packaging containers. The company integrates product formulation, filling, and plastic packaging design and manufacturing to provide one-stop comprehensive services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced technologies in cosmetics formulation, including skin barrier repair, scalp care, and high-efficacy formulas such as sunscreen and whitening. It also utilizes sophisticated plastic packaging technologies like injection molding, blow molding, and soft tube production, supported by in-house mold development and 3D printing for rapid prototyping. Jahen maintains a robust R&D system with multiple specialized laboratories and holds over 200 patents, including invention patents in moisturizing compounds and low-temperature grinding equipment.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Jahen serves major domestic and international daily chemical and cosmetics brands such as Johnson & Johnson, Shanghai Jahwa, Beitaini, Yumeijing, Pechoin, Doterra, Victoria's Secret, Shell, Reckitt Benckiser, Unilever, and Procter & Gamble. Its products cater to cosmetics, household care, and plastic packaging markets, with a focus on brand owners requiring high-quality OEM/ODM services.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with key production bases in Quanzhou, Shanghai, Huzhou, Zhejiang, Tianjin, Zhuhai, and Hong Kong. Domestic sales account for over 94% of revenue, with a smaller portion from overseas markets. Strategic regional layouts cover the West Coast Economic Zone, Yangtze River Delta, Pearl River Delta, and Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jahen operates primarily as a midstream manufacturer and supplier in the daily chemical and plastic packaging supply chain, providing OEM/ODM manufacturing services and packaging solutions to brand owners. It integrates upstream R&D and formulation with downstream production and logistics, offering one-stop supply chain services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous innovation in product formulation and packaging design, focusing on natural plant extracts, anti-allergy, anti-inflammatory, scalp care, and sensory fragrance technologies. It invests in green and intelligent packaging, digital management systems (PLM, MES, WMS, QMS), and expands production capacity with new facilities. Jahen also actively participates in industry standard setting and enhances its R&D talent pool and collaboration with research institutes.
categories.revenue_model: Jahen generates revenue mainly through direct sales of OEM/ODM daily chemical products (cosmetics, household care) and plastic packaging containers. Revenue is recognized upon product delivery and customer acceptance, with sales predominantly conducted via direct sales channels to brand customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with leading domestic and international daily chemical OEM/ODM manufacturers and plastic packaging suppliers. It holds a strong market position as a core supplier to major brands, recognized for high-quality standards, stable production capacity, and integrated service capabilities. Jahen has received multiple awards from clients like Johnson & Johnson, Shanghai Jahwa, and Beitaini, reflecting its competitive advantage in quality and innovation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Jahen reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 922.99 million, a 9.13% decrease from the previous year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 23.7 million. Total assets reached RMB 1.8 billion, up 6.57% year-over-year. The company is in a growth phase with ongoing capacity expansion, especially at its Huzhou base, though current utilization rates are moderate. R&D investment accounted for about 3.7% of revenue, supporting future growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Jahen offers integrated OEM/ODM services combining advanced cosmetics formulation and plastic packaging design, enabling cost reduction and enhanced supply chain efficiency for clients. Its strong R&D capabilities, extensive patent portfolio, and quality management systems ensure high product safety, efficacy, and customization. The company’s one-stop service model and regional multi-site production layout provide responsive, stable supply and innovation support, differentiating it as a preferred partner for leading domestic and international brands.
